title: Watering can with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a90c8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body of watering can -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#3fa9d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#5cc4ef'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#a8e8ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M22 60 L8 40 L14 36 L28 54 Z' fill='#2a90c8'/>
  <path d='M22 58 L10 41 L13 39 L26 54 Z' fill='#5cc4ef'/>
  <!-- spout rose (sprinkler head) -->
  <ellipse cx='9' cy='37' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f5c542' transform='rotate(-38 9 37)'/>
  <circle cx='7' cy='35' r='1' fill='#a87c14'/>

  <circle cx='12' cy='34' r='1' fill='#a87c14'/>

  <path d='M64 46 Q84 42 82 62 Q80 78 60 74' fill='none' stroke='#2a90c8' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 46 Q84 42 82 62 Q80 78 60 74' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='42' rx='20' ry='6' fill='#2a90c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='41' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#186a94'/>
  <!-- dripping water droplets -->
  <ellipse cx='4' cy='26' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#bfefff'/>
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='24' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#bfefff'/>
  <ellipse cx='8' cy='17' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#bfefff'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='58' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#fafcff'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='58' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#fafcff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='59' r='1.6' fill='#186a94'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='59' r='1.6' fill='#186a94'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 67 Q48 74 56 67' fill='none' stroke='#fafcff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='64' r='2.6' fill='#ff9bb8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='64' r='2.6' fill='#ff9bb8' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
